title: Spotted Dick
hookLine: British-inspired spotted dick with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Spotted Dick
steps.instructionTemplate: Put the flour and salt in a bowl. Add the suet, currants, sugar, lemon and orange zest. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m52886_1}, {m52886_2}, {m52886_3}, and {m52886_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure self-raising flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Spotted Dick
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour in 150ml milk and mix to a firm but moist dough, adding the extra milk if necessary. Whisk steadily around the bottom and corners of the pan until glossy, thickened, and smooth enough to coat the back of a spoon. Incorporate {m52886_5}, {m52886_6}, {m52886_7}, {m52886_8}, and {m52886_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Spotted Dick
steps.instructionTemplate: Shape into a fat roll about 20cm long. Place on a large rectangle of baking parchment. Wrap loosely to allow for the pudding to rise and tie the ends with string like a Christmas cracker.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Spotted Dick
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a steamer over a large pan of boiling water, add the pudding to the steamer, cover and steam for 1 1/2 hours. Top up the pan with water from time to time.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Spotted Dick
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove from the steamer and allow to cool slightly before unwrapping. Serve sliced with custard. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.
